hotels.title: Gold Coast Golf Haven with Lagoon Pool, Daily Breakfast & One Round of Golf
hotels.description: Fall in love with the Gold Coast’s laid-back atmosphere at this five-star Sanctuary Cove retreat. This idyllic hideaway is superbly set on over nine acres of tropical gardens and boasts a sprawling one-acre lagoon pool so you can soak up the tropics from every luxurious angle. Dining at this resort is defined by unique culinary experiences. Savour the flavours of wood-fired fare in rustic-chic surrounds at The Fireplace, then dive into a whiskey tasting at the lively Verandah Restaurant & Bar. Treat yourself to high tea or elevate your poolside relaxation with refreshing cocktails and poke bowls influenced by local flavours. Practise your swing on Sanctuary Cove’s acclaimed courses. The Palms offers a strategic, well-bunkered par-70 layout framed by century-old cabbage palms, while The Pines, Australia’s only Arnold Palmer signature course, challenges with lakes, contoured holes and wildlife.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Five-Star Sanctuary Cove Retreat with One-Acre Lagoon Beach Pool
hotels.description: Fall in love with the Gold Coast's laidback atmosphere at InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort, an IHG Hotel. This idyllic hideaway is superbly set on 4.2-hectares of tropical gardens and boasts a sprawling one-acre lagoon pool and four exquisite dining destinations. The world-renowned Gold Coast theme parks are just a 10-minute drive away, and guests can also enjoy easy access to the tranquil Marine Village or critically-acclaimed golf course.
